headline: Metadata-only reapproval. The P0 wave gave field-classification.json the denominator it never carried; entries, classCounts and every artifact byte are untouched, and the counters equal the canonical census exactly. Both NC approvals are re-issued against the same bytes with the moved classification and sidecar hashes repinned.

verdicts.observed: The P0 wave adds four keys to field-classification.json — discoveredFieldsOrAnchors, classifiedFieldsOrAnchors, complete and denominatorBasis — and repins the sidecar's classificationSha256 to match. Nothing else moved. entries and classCounts are byte-identical to the reviewed base, no key was removed or altered, and the counters equal the canonical census exactly: 119 of 119, matching both census fields[] and the declared fieldCount. Source, field map, both fixtures, the contact sheet and every all-page raster hash to the same bytes reviewed at b3e3e98a, with the source SHA recomputed from the official bytes under RCAP_BUNDLE_EXTRACT rather than read from a receipt.
verdicts.visualReviewBasis: not repeated, and not required: no artifact or raster byte changed, so the pages reviewed at b3e3e98a are the pages this record approves.
verdicts.whatIsCorrectlyProtected: Unchanged from b3e3e98a — court, judge, clerk, prosecutor, attorney, agency, service, signature, notarization and decision regions blank on every page; page 2 word-for-word identical to the blank rendering.
verdicts.artifactSafety: Flattened; zero AcroForm fields, no XFA, no JavaScript, no OpenAction or additional actions.
verdicts.advisoryNote: Recorded in the shard record at b3e3e98a and unchanged by this wave. None is a family blocker.
